native_monetization.note: 10 for native paid checkout/licensing; 5 for selective monetization; 0 for external-only or free distribution; unknown when unverified.

sources.method: Manual research and source availability review; see per-metric evidence classification

research_tasks: Verify Slovak publisher onboarding and payout country support
Find 5–10 products first released within 24 months; record launch source separately from latest update
Record current traction and actual payment evidence; do not infer revenue from price or downloads
Sample 10 direct alternatives in one niche, including free options and review concentration
Run a host integration and packaging spike; record manual testing and review effort

deep_dive.status: Initial evidence review; commercial validation incomplete

research_tasks: Verify Slovak publisher onboarding and payout country support
Find 5–10 products first released within 24 months; record launch source separately from latest update
Record current traction and actual payment evidence; do not infer revenue from price or downloads
Sample 10 direct alternatives in one niche, including free options and review concentration
Run a host integration and packaging spike; record manual testing and review effort

deep_dive.status: Initial evidence review; commercial validation incomplete
deep_dive.why_market: Assess a narrow cms utility for SMB users. The official ecosystem provides a publication or extension path; category demand, differentiation and paid entrant traction require a listing-level sample.
deep_dive.why_now: Recent public listing observations exist. No current paid-growth trend is established.
deep_dive.recent_entrant_finding: The bounded official API sample contains recent plugins with install/review traction. Payment and first commercial-release evidence are missing; the proxy is capped at 6/10.
deep_dive.promising_categories: Site administration and data quality — hypotheses, not demonstrated low-competition categories.
deep_dive.paying_categories: Commercial extensions exist, but category-level payment and conversion evidence remains unverified.

ideas.name: Read-only content consistency checker
ideas.validation: Inspect ten direct alternatives and two independent unresolved customer complaints; verify paid entrant traction before a scoped integration spike.

ideas.name: Export field validation preview
ideas.validation: Inspect ten direct alternatives and two independent unresolved customer complaints; verify paid entrant traction before a scoped integration spike.

ideas.name: Media metadata audit
ideas.validation: Inspect ten direct alternatives and two independent unresolved customer complaints; verify paid entrant traction before a scoped integration spike.

deep_dive.avoid: Payment gateways, tax engines, full page builders and large synchronization systems
deep_dive.first_customer_target: 5 paying customers from marketplace discovery as an experiment goal; not a forecast.
deep_dive.validation: Separate free install/review proxies from paying customers and verify the first launch date.
deep_dive.stop_rule: Do not treat a paid plan, high reviews or a simple app as validated demand.
deep_dive.second_pass: Known recent listing proxies are included under the same formula as every marketplace; absent payment data prevents a strong-opportunity verdict.

collection.method: New + popular + five utility searches; bounded, selection-biased sample

deep_dive.status: Initial evidence review; commercial validation incomplete
deep_dive.why_market: Native app subscriptions and a relatively focused business audience make one-board utilities worth testing. A platform pricing advantage does not demonstrate that a new app can acquire paying accounts.
deep_dive.why_now: Native monetization is documented and the platform published a 2025 micro-SaaS portfolio case. The story does not establish first launch dates or marketplace-only customer acquisition.
deep_dive.recent_entrant_finding: No complete set of 5–10 successful recent entrants was verified. Launch dates, current traction and payment must be sourced independently; historical success is insufficient.
deep_dive.promising_categories: Board quality; focused reporting — hypotheses, not measured low-competition categories.
deep_dive.paying_categories: Native monetization is a purchasing mechanism. Category-level willingness to pay still needs current paid listing and customer evidence.
